messages:
kai: Heads up: customer reported budget alerts firing for the wrong project. They used delegated exchange tokens but console shows the SA owner project.
rebecca: Can you paste a minimal repro?
kai: Example: `POST /v1/completions` with `Authorization: Bearer exch-77a`, `X-Delegated-Project: proj-checkout`. Dashboard attributes to sa-owner-project.
devon: Router currently falls back to token owner for SA tokens. Exchange tokens are signed and include `delegated_project` but router doesn't consult it yet.
maria: This is a UX hole for teams that proxy requests via shared SAs. Would be great if console made the distinction explicit.
joyce: UX suggestion: show two columns in quota/usage: "Requested project" and "Attribution (resolved)" with a tooltip describing precedence. Add a small badge when they differ.
rebecca: Telemetry plan: emit `auth.attribution.resolved`, `auth.attribution.source` (exchange|header|token), and `auth.attribution.mismatch` tag per request. Aggregate by org and route.
devon: Dev plan: (1) add metrics + sparse audit log behind FF, (2) implement resolution order: verified exchange claim -> validated X-Delegated-Project -> token owner, behind FF, (3) console API and toggle per org.
billing-bot: Created ticket INFRA-5012: delegated attribution resolver + telemetry + FF (retain audit 30d).
maria: Rollout: collect telemetry 10-14 days, pilot with 3 opt-in orgs, 1% traffic canary, then scale. Keep default as token-owner until legal/sales sign-off.
joyce: I'll prototype the table microcopy and the org setting labeled "Attribution mode: token-owner | delegated-first".
rebecca: Also add tests for tampered exchange tokens so we only trust `delegated_project` when `proof_verified=true`.
devon: Will split into small PRs. Ping me for billing ETL sample payload: `resolved_attribution=proj-checkout,source=exchange,verified=true`.
kai: Thanks everyone. Please post PR links and dashboard preview here when ready. No immediate release blocker — telemetry first.
